exposure: Mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery, lower uterine cesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: 278 postnatal mothers who gave live birth at a government tertiary hospital in Bangladesh
finding: Women who had normal vaginal deliveries reported higher levels of fulfillment and lower levels of physical discomfort and emotional distress compared to those who underwent lower uterine cesarean section or instrumental delivery.
mod_finding: Women who had normal vaginal deliveries reported higher levels of fulfillment and lower levels of physical discomfort and emotional distress compared to those who underwent lower uterine cesarean section or instrumental delivery.
